sentences.text: Milica Bogdanovna `` Milla '' JovovichSerbian Cyrillic : Милица Јововић ; Милица Йовович Милиця Йовович -LRB- -LSB- ˈjoʊvəvɪtʃ -RSB- ; born December 17 , 1975 -RRB- is an American actress , model , musician , and fashion designer .
She has appeared in numerous science fiction and action films , leading the music channel VH1 to deem her the `` reigning queen of kick-butt '' in 2006 .	science fiction	science fiction film	VH1	VH1
In 2004 , she was the highest-paid model in the world according to Forbes .	Forbes	Forbes
Born in Kiev , Jovovich emigrated with her parents to the United States when she was five .	Kiev	Kiev
In 1987 , she began modeling at the age of 12 when Herb Ritts photographed her for the cover of the Italian magazine Lei .	Herb Ritts	Herb Ritts
Richard Avedon featured her in Revlon 's `` Most Unforgettable Women in the World '' advertisements .	Richard Avedon	Richard Avedon	Revlon	Revlon

In 1988 , Jovovich had her first acting role in the television film The Night Train to Kathmandu , and that year also appeared in her first feature film , Two Moon Junction .	The Night Train to Kathmandu	The Night Train to Kathmandu	Two Moon Junction	Two Moon Junction
Jovovich gained attention for her role in the explicit 1991 romance film Return to the Blue Lagoon , as she was then only 15 .	Return to the Blue Lagoon	Return to the Blue Lagoon

She was considered to have a breakthrough with her role in the 1997 French science-fiction film The Fifth Element written and directed by Luc Besson .	Luc Besson	Luc Besson	The Fifth Element	The Fifth Element
She and Besson married that year , but soon divorced .
She starred as the heroine and martyr in Besson 's The Messenger : The Story of Joan of Arc -LRB- 1999 -RRB- .

In 2002 , Jovovich starred in the science fiction horror film Resident Evil , adapted from the video game series of the same name .	science fiction	science fiction film	Resident Evil	Resident Evil (film)	video game series of the same name	Resident Evil
It received negative reviews from critics , but was commercially successful .
She reprised her role in five sequels , all in the apocalyptic fiction action horror genre , made between 2004 and 2016 .	five sequels	Resident Evil (film series)#Films
Jovovich released an album , The Divine Comedy , in 1994 .	The Divine Comedy	The Divine Comedy (Milla Jovovich album)
She continues to release demos for other songs on her official website and contributes to film soundtracks .
In 2003 , she and model Carmen Hawk created the clothing line Jovovich-Hawk .	Jovovich-Hawk	Jovovich-Hawk
Jovovich has her own production company , Creature Entertainment .
